steps.caption: JOB-simulate · setup: build the sim command
JOB-simulate.R1 · sim run prints the 11 lines in order and exits with 0
JOB-simulate.R1 · the first three lines are strategy greedy, days 365 and seed 1
JOB-simulate.R1 · --pv 0: solar 0.0 kWh and self-consumption 0.0 %
JOB-simulate.R1 · shift, 30 days, latitude 45: the values equal the library
JOB-simulate.R1 · none, no battery: export equals solar less self-used
steps.run: .lake/build/bin/sim run --strategy none --battery 0 | grep -E '^(solar|self-used|export) ' && .lake/build/bin/sim run --strategy none --battery 0 | awk '/^solar/{s=$2} /^self-used/{u=$2} /^export/{e=$2} END{print "solar - self-used = " s-u ", export = " e}'

steps.caption: JOB-simulate.R1 · --days 3650 exits with 0 and shows 3650 days
steps.run: out=$(.lake/build/bin/sim run --days 3650); code=$?; echo "$out" | grep '^days'; echo "exit $code"

steps.caption: JOB-simulate.R2 · --monthly: the header and 12 rows from Jan to Dec
JOB-simulate.R2 · --monthly --days 400: 14 rows, the last two Jan and Feb
JOB-simulate.R2 · --monthly --lat 45: Jul solar is more than twice Dec solar
JOB-simulate.R2 · without --monthly, sim run prints only the 11 lines
JOB-simulate.R3 · sim compare: the header and none, greedy, evening, shift
JOB-simulate.R3 · --seed 9 --lat 45: the greedy row equals sim run
JOB-simulate.R3 · --lat 45: greedy has more self-consumption than none
JOB-simulate.R3 · sim compare --strategy greedy gives UNKNOWN_OPTION, exit 2
JOB-simulate.R4 · --seed 5 two times gives the same output
steps.run: .lake/build/bin/sim run --seed 5 > /tmp/a.txt; .lake/build/bin/sim run --seed 5 > /tmp/b.txt; cmp /tmp/a.txt /tmp/b.txt && echo 'the two outputs are the same'
